class.name: ResonancePlayerConfig
class.brief_description: Per-source Steam Audio settings for ResonancePlayer. Save as .tres for reusable presets.
class.description: Assign to [member ResonancePlayer.player_config] for occlusion, distance, air absorption, directivity, reflections, pathing, and mix levels. Without a config the player is plain [AudioStreamPlayer3D]. Pathing volume stays on the player node ([member ResonancePlayer.pathing_probe_volume]).

method.name: get_bus_name_effective
method.description: Effective bus for Direct + Pathing. Use Global = [param global_fallback]; Custom = [member bus_name] or fallback if empty.

method.name: get_reverb_bus_name_effective
method.description: Effective reverb bus. Use Global = [param global_fallback]; Custom = [member reverb_bus_name] or fallback if empty.

method.name: get_editor_reverb_bus_override_warning
method.description: Editor hint when Custom reverb bus is set under Convolution/TAN (split routing only affects Parametric/Hybrid). Empty string when OK.

method.name: create_default
method.description: Creates a default config for sources without one assigned.

members.member: Master distance-attenuation switch. When off, Direct gain stays 1 and Phonon uses the default distance model on all slots; mode/min/max remain stored.

[code]0[/code] Inverse (1/d with [member min_distance], ignores [member max_distance]), [code]1[/code] Linear, [code]2[/code] Curve, [code]3[/code] Disabled. See [constant ResonancePlayer.ATTENUATION_INVERSE]. Same TYPE feeds Direct (Euclid), Pathing (path length), and Reflections (IR correction); Linear/Curve Reflections CALLBACK only when [member use_distance_curve_for_reflections].
Distance (m) at full volume. Inverse uses this as the 1/d knee; Linear/Curve use it as the near end of the rolloff.
Far end for Linear/Curve rolloff. Grayed out for Inverse and Disabled; Phonon InverseDistance has no max.
Custom rolloff when [member attenuation_mode] is Curve.
When Linear/Curve: feed the Phonon CALLBACK model into Reflections IR correction. Default off. Pathing always uses CALLBACK for Linear/Curve on path length (no extra Direct mix multiply).
Serialized occlusion radius (same as [member occlusion_radius]). Prefer [member occlusion_radius] in the Occlusion group; this key remains for .tres compatibility.
Occlusion / volumetric sampling radius in meters. Aliases [member source_radius].
Enable distance-based air absorption on the direct path.
[code]0[/code] Simulation, [code]1[/code] User Defined (use low/mid/high).
Low-band (<=800 Hz) EQ when User Defined. [code]0[/code] = full attenuate, [code]1[/code] = unchanged.
Mid-band (800 Hz-8 kHz) EQ when User Defined.
High-band (>=8 kHz) EQ when User Defined.
Direct + Pathing bus: [code]-1[/code] Use Global ([member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.bus]), [code]0[/code] Custom ([member bus_name]).
Bus when [member bus_override] is Custom. Must exist in the Audio Bus Layout.
[code]-1[/code] Use Global, [code]0[/code] Custom. For Parametric/Hybrid selects the split wet bus; Convolution/TAN stay on the global reverb mixer.
Parametric/Hybrid split wet bus when Custom. Convolution/TAN wet stays on [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.reverb_bus_name].
Enable directional emission pattern.
Dipole mix: [code]0[/code] omni, [code]1[/code] full dipole (Simulation Defined).
Pattern sharpness (0-4) when Simulation Defined.
[code]0[/code] Simulation (dipole), [code]1[/code] User Defined ([member directivity_value]).
Manual directivity (0-1) when User Defined.
Minimum seconds between full playback-parameter updates. [code]0[/code] = every frame (subject to other gating).
Minimum source movement (m) to trigger a full update with [member playback_parameter_min_interval].
Smoothing time (s) for simulated occlusion/transmission. [code]0[/code] = off. Simulation Defined only.
Per-source reflections toggle. Still gated by [member reflections_mix_level] and [member ResonanceServer.output_reverb].
[code]-1[/code] Use Global, [code]0[/code] Realtime, [code]1[/code] Baked Reverb, [code]2[/code] Static Source, [code]3[/code] Static Listener.
[code]-1[/code] Use Global, [code]0[/code] Disabled, [code]1[/code] Enabled.

[code]0[/code] Simulation, [code]1[/code] User Defined ([member occlusion_value]).
Manual occlusion (0-1) when User Defined.
[code]2[/code] Use Global, [code]0[/code] Raycast, [code]1[/code] Volumetric ([member occlusion_samples]).
Volumetric occlusion rays (1-64). Inspector editable only when override is Volumetric.
When false, skip transmission simulation; use User Defined bands.
[code]0[/code] Simulation, [code]1[/code] User Defined (low/mid/high).

High-band transmission (0-1) when User Defined.
